title: Less time on my phone
instructions: Sara telefon kullanımını nasıl azalttığını anlatıyor. Uzun bir metin; önceki ve şimdiki durumu karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Last year, I decided to stop using my phone so much. I was spending about six hours a day on it, mostly on social media.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I felt tired all the time, and I wasn't sleeping well.

script.speaker: s
script.text: So I made some rules. No phone in the bedroom, no phone during meals, and no social media after eight in the evening.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The first two weeks were really hard. I kept picking up my phone without thinking.

script.speaker: s
script.text: But slowly, things changed. I started reading again. In one year, I've read twenty-five books!

script.speaker: s
script.text: I also sleep much better, and I spend more time with my friends face to face.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I still use my phone for messages and maps, but now it's about two hours a day.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I think everyone should try it, even for just one week.

questions.prompt: How many hours a day did Sara use her phone before?
questions.evidence: I was spending about six hours a day on it

questions.prompt: What was one of her rules?
questions.feedback: Kurallardan biri yatak odasında telefon olmaması.

questions.evidence: The first two weeks were really hard.

questions.feedback: Bir yılda yirmi beş kitap okudu.
questions.evidence: In one year, I've read twenty-five books!

questions.evidence: now it's about two hours a day.
